content:
jamie: RC ready for sign-off: rc-2026-03-21-01 (build 2026.03.21.1). Small change set: prefix caching improvements + quantization profile tweak. No DB migrations. Target promo window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Requesting SRE + QA ack, and a pin during promotion.

deploybot: [deploybot] preflight: artifacts verified, checksum OK, smoke tests queued. To promote:```/deploy promote --version=rc-2026-03-21-01 --env=prod --pin=true```

elaine: oncall is @mateo, pinging him. I can take SRE guard for the promo. What's the KV-warm plan?

oncall-mateo: I'm oncall for the window. 18:00 UTC works for me. I'll monitor telemetry and ready to trigger rollback if thresholds hit. Canary plan please.

jamie: Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% final (5m hold). Alert thresholds: error rate >1% OR embed service errors >0.5% OR p95 latency +20% over baseline.

priya: QA finished quick smoke on staging, no regressions on the core prompt set. Release notes: - improved prefix caching reduces cold latency - updated quantization profile (safer rounding). No schema/migration. I'll sign off from QA once SRE ok.

elaine: SRE ask: include explicit rollback target (model v2.3.4) and pin the artifact on promotion. Also add KV-warm step at T-10.

jamie: noted. Uploaded release notes to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.example/RC-2026-03-21-01. I'll run kv_warm at T-12 and lock migrations.

deploybot: Promote request queued. Approvals required: SRE (elaine), QA (priya). Current approvals: none. Use `/deploy approve --thread=1712223334` to record.

priya: approving — lgtm from QA and product.

elaine: approving — SRE ack. KV warm command:```./scripts/kv_warm --model rc-2026-03-21-01 --timeout 1200``` run at T-12 (approx 17:48 UTC).

jamie: running kv_warm now (T-12). Locking DB migrations for the window.

deploybot: Deploy started by jamie at 1712223450. Canary (10%) rollout initiated. Logs: `canary/rc-2026-03-21-01: start`

ops-bot: Canary metrics (5m): p95 latency +3ms vs baseline, error rate 0.02% :thumbsup:

oncall-mateo: monitoring now. Runbook ready: if error rate >1% or spike sustained >3m I will trigger rollback.

jamie: promote to 50% when ready.

deploybot: ramping to 50%... traffic shift complete. Observability: error rate 0.15% (within threshold). p50/p95 stable.

priya: seeing a minor tokenization variance on one internal prompt, not user-facing and within tolerance. QA stays green.

ops-bot: 50% -> 100% scheduled in 10m after no regressions.

jamie: kicking final ramp to 100%. Pinning artifact: `rc-2026-03-21-01` to prod ring.

deploybot: Promotion to prod completed at 1712223512. Artifact pinned. Post-deploy smoke checks: all OK. Release notes pushed. :tada:

elaine: nice job everyone. We'll keep rollback window open for 2 hours, but rollback disabled unless oncall triggers.

oncall-mateo: I'll keep watch for the next 120 minutes and will trigger rollback if I see anomalies. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/rollback-promote

priya: I'll update the customer release digest and internal changelog.

jamie: thanks all — closing thread.
